# Exterior-kit verification

Report assembled from captured command outputs at `2026-11-03T06:02:22.511550+00:00`.

## Result

**PASS: 53/53 tests, 53/53 per-test mutations killed, independent complete validator and payload gates with no changes from this PR.**

The library contains 65 near roots and the same number of LOD1 roots. The manifest declares `complete: true` and `libraryOnly: true`. All new work stays within the requested exterior-kit namespace; existing files, game modules and production registries are unchanged.

## Branch and base

- Branch: `codex/la-ladera-exterior-kit`.
- Latest `origin/main` used when starting: `6740a624e597bbed9c9f400d6c33b37924777a17`.
- Fetched and rebased once before opening the PR onto `origin/main` at `958d0ec69716d0588a7bb8d4534c336edd550f7e`; see the fresh fetch/rebase transcripts below.
- Full acceptance was rerun after that rebase. Nothing was merged, tagged or released.

## Measured library budgets

| Gate | Actual | Limit |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Designs | 65 | 120 |
| Near GLB | 2,629,920 bytes | Included below |
| LOD1 GLB | 653,108 bytes | Included below |
| Combined GLBs | 3,283,028 bytes | 4,500,000 bytes |
| Texture disk bytes | 6,083,057 | 8,000,000 |
| All textures resident, including complete mip chains | 37,749,372 bytes | 40,000,000 bytes |
| Largest near piece | 4,694 triangles | 6,000 |
| Largest small prop | 1,884 triangles | 2,000 |
| Highest LOD1/near ratio | 36.5854% | 40% |

Near geometry totals 66,438 triangles; LOD1 totals 13,932. The largest near piece is `extkit_lattice_flower`, the largest small prop is `extkit_grille_6`, and the highest ratio occurs at `extkit_grille_7`. The inventory hashes 43 payload/catalogue artifacts; a manifest cannot hash itself.

The texture reader independently inflates and decodes all 396 wall mip images. Every opposite edge matches exactly after block compression, including the normal and ORM planes. BC5 X/Y components stay within the valid positive-Z hemisphere. Geometry bounds, winding, normals, indices, atlas UV cells, triangle counts, anchor planes and every LOD ratio are read from the actual GLB binary.

## Repository payload before and after

The existing `tests/payload.mjs` was run before adding assets and again after the final rebase. This PR does not change any of its limits. Its displayed MB are MiB (1,048,576 bytes).

| Gate | Before | After rebase | Existing gate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| textures | 27.82 MiB | 33.62 MiB | 40 MiB |
| models | 34.56 MiB | 37.87 MiB | 40 MiB |
| shipped total (excl. vendor,dev,labs,tests,tools) | 65.71 MiB | 74.83 MiB | 150 MiB |
| estimated GPU texture memory | 505.00 MiB | 509.00 MiB | 800 MiB |

The fresh upstream base changed the following sub-limit between the before and after runs; this change is not part of the exterior-kit diff:

- `models/people`: 14 → 40 MiB upstream; measured 9.38 MiB after rebase, also below the earlier limit.

The total models gate remains 40 MiB. The upstream change is preserved in `logs/upstream-payload-gate-diff.log`.

The unchanged global payload script recognises PNG/JPEG/WebP dimensions and does not account for KTX2 GPU blocks. Its PNG total already includes this library's atlas. Adding the independently decoded wall blocks (33,555,072 bytes) gives a conservative project total of approximately **541.00 MiB**, still below the unchanged 800 MiB gate. This is compressed-format residency, not an uncompressed fallback estimate.

## Visual evidence

The contact sheets cover every near and LOD piece. Individual cameras are orthographic and independently framed; captions give metre envelopes and actual triangles. The two perspective views are from cameras 1.60 m above their respective walking planes. They use exported GLBs and decode the shipped compressed wall files. Source hashes are pinned in `source-pins-all.json`; the render command rejects changes to its inputs during rendering.

## Corrections preserved in the logs

Initial exploratory failures were corrected rather than hidden: the first texture set exceeded the disk budget; low-bit normal/ORM entropy was reduced without reducing map resolution. Geometry probes caught envelope/LOD issues, and actual GLB inspection caught folded plant-bracket normals; separate welded members fixed the geometry. The first visual sample exposed Blender's black default for a missing vertex-colour attribute; the preview now supplies glTF's white default on imported copies. The anchor audit replaced catalogue-envelope offsets with measured rear clearance planes. Both GLBs remained byte-identical across that metadata correction. The full visual pass then caught detached fern leaflets and coincident frame faces; leaf bases now follow their actual stems, and crossing rails have a deliberate 1 mm depth separation. The review assembly also received proper wall/support placement and a studio floor below the roof slab. The final sheet audit exposed reversed coplanar shutter faces and a tube-frame twist at the elbow bend; thin solid hoods and a stable bend frame corrected those five designs. The review cable span was also moved into the clear gap between the two facades. `review-all-01` was deliberately interrupted for the anchor correction and is not final evidence. The earlier `review-all-02` and `review-all-03` images are superseded. Final contact/view evidence comes from `review-all-04`.

The all-file whitespace check reports one trailing space printed by a geometry probe. Raw command transcripts are preserved verbatim; the subsequent source/documentation whitespace check excludes raw logs and their embedded transcript copy in this report.

## Original work and drawn strings

All geometry and images are original deterministic procedural work. No scraped or downloaded art, brands or manufacturer logos were used. The [CC0 note](LICENSE.md) covers the new work while preserving the licences of imported existing helpers. No strings are drawn on the pieces or texture planes; the chalkboard cell is blank. Spanish catalogue/review captions, including añil, pañete, baldosín and celosía, were checked. The requested list describes eleven wall finishes while asking for twelve; damp tolete brick is the documented twelfth finish.

## Not verified

**Runtime integration in the game is untested.** No production loader, material registry or game module imports this library. Native KTX2 GPU upload, compressed-format support on target devices, production normal reconstruction, runtime placement, collision/occlusion, wind/cloth animation, interactive chalk writing, game draw calls/frame time and boot/load timing are untested. An RGBA fallback would have a different memory cost and is neither implemented nor claimed to meet the 40 MB limit. Plant anchors use a foliage-inclusive rear clearance plane, not a shelf bolt position. Capacity labels and service equipment are visual scenery approximations. The offline review architecture is illustrative and is not included in the asset library.

## Captured command transcripts

These are fresh captured outputs, not expected-output examples. Failed/interrupted development attempts are retained alongside the passing final commands. The outer logger records UTC and exit status; Blender's internal clock text reflects its process timezone. Individual files in `logs/` remain available for direct inspection.
